expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "CONTRIBUTING.md is training, and training degrades — you need a device that makes unformatted/untyped code impossible to merge"

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
expectations.evidence: "**Pre-commit hook** (via husky/lefthook/pre-commit) that runs the same check locally"

expectations.text: Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: Does not explicitly mention --no-verify; only implies pre-commit can be skipped via "this is the one that actually matters, since it can't be skipped"

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
expectations.evidence: "CI check that fails the PR if ... the type checker reports errors"

expectations.text: Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
expectations.evidence: "**A baseline/ratchet** for existing untyped code so the gate only blocks *new* violations, not the whole legacy tree at once"

expectations.text: Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: Recommends devices and actual implementation, not documentation
